newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Austria merchant bank ups share in Ukraine bank.
newsitem.headline: Austria merchant bank ups share in Ukraine bank.

text.p: Vienna-based European Privatisation and Investment Corp (EPIC) said on Thursday it has increased its stake in Ukraine's KINTO Investments and Securities to 40.0 percent from 24.5 percent.
"This increased stake demonstrates EPIC's commitment to Ukraine and its views on growth prospects in this important market of 51 million people," an EPIC statement said.
KINTO, an investment bank and broker, has concentrated on investing in the mass privatisation process, including accumulating privatisation vouchers to buy shares in formerly state-owned enterprises.
EPIC acquired its initial stake in KINTO in 1994, and together with U.S. investment bank Wasserstein Perella launched Ukraine's first foreign equity fund, New Ukraine Partners.
